boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Rice spaces for studying, meeting, recreation, and campus events, supported by current university sources.

cards.title: Brochstein Pavilion
cards.subtitle: Central Quad, beside Fondren Library
cards.notes: Bring a classmate for a small-group work session or conversation, then use the indoor and outdoor seating as a campus pause point.
cards.short_summary: A glass pavilion built for studying, conversation, and informal meetings.
cards.evidence_claim: Rice identifies Brochstein Pavilion as a place for small-group meetings, studying, and conversations between faculty and students.
cards.access_notes: Food and beverages are available on site; check current campus dining information before planning a visit.

cards.title: Rice Coffeehouse
cards.subtitle: Rice Memorial Center & Ley Student Center
cards.notes: Use this student-operated café for a conversational study session or a low-stakes group project near the student center.
cards.short_summary: A student-operated coffeehouse that supports study and conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: Rice lists the student-operated Rice Coffeehouse among places used for small-group meetings, studying, and conversations.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Rice Memorial Center & Ley Student Center; food or drinks may require purchase.

cards.title: Fondren Library
cards.subtitle: Central campus library
cards.notes: Choose a common area for independent work, reserve a study room when available, or head upstairs when you need a quieter setting.
cards.short_summary: Rice’s library offers common study areas, reservable rooms, and a Rice-only quiet floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Fondren’s floor maps identify its sixth floor as a Rice-only quiet study space and link to study-room reservations.
cards.access_notes: Sixth-floor quiet study requires a Rice ID; study rooms use the library’s reservation system.

cards.entity_name: Rice Memorial Center & Ley Student Center
cards.title: Rice Memorial Center & Ley Student Center
cards.subtitle: Student-center hub
cards.notes: Start here when your group needs a meeting point: the center contains gathering areas, student-group rooms, dining, and campus services.
cards.short_summary: The all-student hub combines services, gathering space, and meeting rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Rice describes the Rice Memorial Center & Ley Student Center as the hub for all students and says it has meeting rooms for student groups.
cards.source_title: Rice Memorial Center - Ley Student Center | Campus Events
cards.access_notes: Some rooms and event spaces may require a reservation through Campus Events.

cards.title: Grand Hall
cards.subtitle: Rice Memorial Center & Ley Student Center
cards.notes: Look for lectures, receptions, or large campus gatherings here, and coordinate with the host rather than treating it as open drop-in space.
cards.short_summary: A large student-center venue configured for lectures, receptions, and dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Rice lists Grand Hall 101 in the student center for dining, receptions, and lectures, with lecture capacity of 450.
cards.source_title: Rice Memorial Center - Ley Student Center | Campus Events
cards.access_notes: Attend scheduled events or arrange use through the relevant campus event process.

cards.title: Farnsworth Pavilion
cards.subtitle: Rice Memorial Center & Ley Student Center
cards.notes: Keep this pavilion in mind for a planned student-organization meeting, lecture, dining event, or reception in the student center.
cards.short_summary: A flexible student-center pavilion for medium-size gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Rice lists Farnsworth Pavilion 127 for dining, receptions, and lectures, with capacity for up to 100 in a lecture setup.
cards.source_title: Rice Memorial Center - Ley Student Center | Campus Events
cards.access_notes: This is an event venue; confirm event access or reservation requirements in advance.

cards.title: Ray Courtyard
cards.subtitle: Outdoor space at Rice Memorial Center & Ley Student Center
cards.notes: Use the courtyard as an outdoor rendezvous point before a campus event, or reserve it through the appropriate process for a group gathering.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor student-center setting for meetings, dining, and receptions.
cards.evidence_claim: Rice lists Ray Courtyard as an outdoor space used for receptions, dining, and meetings, with capacity of 300.
cards.source_title: Rice Memorial Center - Ley Student Center | Campus Events
cards.access_notes: Outdoor events and organized use may require reservation or host approval.

cards.title: Brown Garden
cards.subtitle: Outdoor space at Rice Memorial Center & Ley Student Center
cards.notes: Plan a small outdoor meet-up here or watch for hosted receptions and meetings; bring what you need because it is an event-oriented space.
cards.short_summary: A named student-center garden used for outdoor gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Rice lists Brown Garden as an outdoor space for receptions, dining, and meetings, with capacity of 100.
cards.source_title: Rice Memorial Center - Ley Student Center | Campus Events
cards.access_notes: Outdoor events and organized use may require reservation or host approval.

cards.title: Sammy’s
cards.subtitle: Rice Memorial Center & Ley Student Center
cards.notes: Check the campus calendar for conferences, receptions, or group gatherings held here, then use the venue as a clear student-center meeting landmark.
cards.short_summary: A student-center venue that hosts varied large-group functions.
cards.evidence_claim: Rice lists Sammy’s in the student center for receptions, dining, meetings, and conferences, with capacity of 200.
cards.source_title: Rice Memorial Center - Ley Student Center | Campus Events
cards.access_notes: Access depends on scheduled activity; event use may require reservation.

cards.entity_name: Barbara and David Gibbs Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.title: Gibbs Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.subtitle: Rice campus recreation facility
cards.notes: Meet a friend for an active break or use the facility for physical activity, following current recreation-center entry and equipment policies.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation facility used by Rice students, faculty, and staff.
cards.evidence_claim: Rice states that students, faculty, and staff use the Barbara and David Gibbs Recreation and Wellness Center to promote physical activity.
cards.access_notes: Follow current recreation-center access and participation policies.
